lead: Every metric across all {count} control steps. The dashed line marks the selected step.
legend.cursor: The dashed line and the dot mark the selected step.
legend.dash: A dash means the value was not computed: it does not exist, it is not a zero.
legend.delta: The number next to the value is the change from the previous step.
legend.line: The line is the metric across all control steps; colour only tells the cards apart.
legend.marks: Ticks under the time scale are field events: green — commissioned, orange — converted to injection, red — shut in.
legend.span: The card footer shows the first and last value over the horizon.
legend.title: Encoding
